masker.contract: For each current Top-3 hypothesis, follow its frozen 106-107 track partner, replay both SAM masks, union both lifted point sets, project depth-visible support into frame 200, and apply one native action-view SAM prompt.

evaluation.truth_role: Form all three two-frame track unions, transported prompts, and action masks before reading the action target box.

transport.ranking: Preserve current geometry-track order and its frozen initial-frame partners; no truth, target appearance, detector, SAM score, scale expansion, or reranking.
transport.action_candidate: Tight rectangle of one native action-view SAM mask prompted by the depth-consistent projection of the two-frame 3D union.

gate.requirements: At least one of three fixed-budget union-transport candidates must reach action-view IoU 0.8, and the result must report its delta over both detector-track and single-view transport ceilings.

literature_motivation.name: SAMPro3D
literature_motivation.use: Accumulate view-consistent 3D prompt evidence before re-prompting SAM.

literature_motivation.name: MV3DIS
literature_motivation.use: Use 3D-guided multi-view mask tracks as a distinct candidate source.

next_action: Freeze the covisibility selector and two-frame track-union transport on queue row 4 before source acquisition for source-disjoint confirmation.
fallback_action: Seal the consumed Development negative; do not add scale expansion, more candidates, or tuned prompt margins on row 3.
claim_boundary: This consumed-family Development test evaluates only whether two initial views provide enough 3D extent to recover one action-view target-region candidate. It does not confirm generalization, select the correct target identity, or establish portal access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, or safety.
